CommitContainer.title: CommitContainer
CommitContainer.summary: Call the CommitContainer operation to create an asynchronous task that saves a specified container in an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instance as an image and pushes the image to an image repository in Alibaba Cloud Container Registry (ACR).

CopyDataCache.title: CopyDataCache
CopyDataCache.summary: Copies a data cache from one region to another.

CreateContainerGroup.title: Create a container group
CreateContainerGroup.summary: Calls CreateContainerGroup to create an ECI instance (container group).

CreateImageCache.title: CreateImageCache
CreateImageCache.summary: You can call the CreateImageCache operation to create an image cache. This accelerates image pulling and reduces the startup time for Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances.

CreateInstanceOpsTask.title: CreateInstanceOpsTask
CreateInstanceOpsTask.summary: Call CreateInstanceOpsTask to create an Operations and Maintenance (O&M) task.

CreateVirtualNode.title: CreateVirtualNode
CreateVirtualNode.summary: Creates a virtual node to connect a self-managed Kubernetes cluster to ECI and scale out resources.

DeleteContainerGroup.title: DeleteContainerGroup
DeleteContainerGroup.summary: You can call DeleteContainerGroup to delete an ECI instance.

DeleteImageCache.title: DeleteImageCache
DeleteImageCache.summary: You can call this operation to delete an image cache.

DeleteVirtualNode.title: DeleteVirtualNode
DeleteVirtualNode.summary: You can call the DeleteVirtualNode operation to delete a virtual node.

DescribeAvailableResource.title: DescribeAvailableResource
DescribeAvailableResource.summary: You can call the DescribeAvailableResource operation to query the ECS instance families that are available in a specified region and zone.

DescribeCommitContainerTask.title: DescribeCommitContainerTask
DescribeCommitContainerTask.summary: The DescribeCommitContainerTask operation queries the details of a CommitContainer task.

DescribeContainerGroupEvents.title: DescribeContainerGroupEvents
DescribeContainerGroupEvents.summary: Queries events for multiple Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances in a batch.

DescribeContainerGroupMetric.title: DescribeContainerGroupMetric
DescribeContainerGroupMetric.summary: Queries the monitoring data of an Elastic Container Instance (ECI).

DescribeContainerGroupPrice.title: DescribeContainerGroupPrice
DescribeContainerGroupPrice.summary: Queries the price of an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instance.

DescribeContainerGroupStatus.title: DescribeContainerGroupStatus
DescribeContainerGroupStatus.summary: You can call DescribeContainerGroupStatus to perform a batch query on the status of multiple Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances.

DescribeContainerGroups.title: DescribeContainerGroups
DescribeContainerGroups.summary: You can call DescribeContainerGroups to query information about multiple ECI instances.

DescribeContainerLog.title: DescribeContainerLog
DescribeContainerLog.summary: Queries the logs of a container in a container group.

DescribeDataCaches.title: DescribeDataCaches
DescribeDataCaches.summary: Queries the details of one or more data caches.

DescribeImageCaches.title: DescribeImageCaches
DescribeImageCaches.summary: Queries the details of one or more image caches.

DescribeInstanceOpsRecords.title: DescribeInstanceOpsRecords
DescribeInstanceOpsRecords.summary: You can call DescribeInstanceOpsRecords to query the O&M task records for an instance.

DescribeMultiContainerGroupMetric.title: DescribeMultiContainerGroupMetric
DescribeMultiContainerGroupMetric.summary: You can call the DescribeContainerGroupMetric operation to query the monitoring data of an ECI instance.

DescribeRegions.title: DescribeRegions
DescribeRegions.summary: Queries the regions and zones supported by Elastic Container Instance.

DescribeVirtualNodes.title: DescribeVirtualNodes
DescribeVirtualNodes.summary: Queries the details of one or more virtual nodes.

ExecContainerCommand.title: ExecContainerCommand
ExecContainerCommand.summary: Executes a command in a container.

ListTagResources.title: ListTagResources
ListTagResources.summary: You can call the ListTagResources operation to query the tags that are attached to ECI resources.

ListUsage.title: ListUsage
ListUsage.summary: Call the ListUsage operation to query the privilege quotas in a specified region. The response returns the used amount and the upper limit of each quota.

ResizeContainerGroupVolume.title: ResizeContainerGroupVolume
ResizeContainerGroupVolume.summary: You can call the ResizeContainerGroupVolume operation to resize a disk volume mounted to a specified Elastic Container Instance (ECI).

RestartContainerGroup.title: RestartContainerGroup
RestartContainerGroup.summary: The RestartContainerGroup operation restarts an ECI instance.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: The TagResources operation attaches tags to specified ECI resources.

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: You can call UntagResources to detach tags from specified ECI resources.

UpdateVirtualNode.title: UpdateVirtualNode
UpdateVirtualNode.summary: You can call the UpdateVirtualNode operation to update the properties of a virtual node.
